checkout.open: Lets the product page's demo button lead to the checkout, per country.
checkout.demo_guard: Keeps every checkout in demo mode: nothing is charged.
checkout.discount_codes: Shows the "Add a discount code" link at checkout, per country. Codes themselves are made and disabled under Discounts.

account.open: Opens the customer account and its privacy requests, everywhere or per language.

invoice.issue: Issues an invoice for every paid live order to this country. Turn on only after the accountant has signed off the VAT setup.

payments.stripe: Lets buyers pay through Stripe wherever checkout is open. Off sends new checkouts back to demo mode.
payments.balance_fetch: Fetches each payment's fee, settled amount and currency conversion from Stripe. Off: the fetches wait and finance shows fees pending; nothing is lost.

reviews.invite: Sends one review email to every delivered order, a day after the photo.
reviews.trustpilot: Copies each review email to Trustpilot, which then invites the buyer too.

routing.auto: Offers each paid order to florists automatically, per country. Off: paid orders there come to you instead, and are cancelled and refunded at the end of their grace time if nobody acts.

notifications.email: Sends order emails to buyers, florists and you. Off: every email waits and goes out once this is on again. Nothing is dropped.

payouts.accrue: Writes what each florist is owed: the price fixed when they accept, their prepaid orders and their payout lines. Off: payout work waits and is done once this is on again. Nothing is dropped.

alerts.push: Push founder alerts to the phone. Production pushes unless this is off; staging pushes only while it is on. Email is always sent.

marketing.basket_reminder: Sends one basket reminder email, only to buyers who ticked the box at checkout. Off: the box is hidden and nothing is sent; links in emails already sent keep working.

flags.orphanLine: Not in the registry. It cannot be changed here.
flags.notSeeded: Not in the database yet. It cannot be changed here.

demo_guard.off: Checkouts will stop being demonstrations wherever checkout is open. Type the flag's name to confirm.
demo_guard.on: Every checkout will be a demonstration again: nothing is charged. Type the flag's name to confirm.

stripe.off: New checkouts will go back to demo mode. Orders already paid keep moving. Type the flag's name to confirm.
stripe.on: Checkouts will take payments through Stripe wherever checkout is open. Type the flag's name to confirm.

invite.on: Every delivered order will get one review email a day after its photo. Type the flag's name to confirm.
invite.off: No more review emails will be sent; waiting invitations expire after 30 days. Type the flag's name to confirm.

trustpilot.on: Each review email will be copied to Trustpilot's invitation address. Type the flag's name to confirm.
trustpilot.off: Review emails will no longer be copied to Trustpilot. Type the flag's name to confirm.

auto.off: Paid orders to this country will no longer be offered to florists. Each one comes to you, and is cancelled and refunded at the end of its grace time if nobody acts. Type the flag's name to confirm.
auto.on: Paid orders to this country will be offered to florists automatically again. Type the flag's name to confirm.

email.off: No order email will be sent until this is on again. Emails wait and are not lost. Type the flag's name to confirm.
email.on: Order emails will be sent again, including the ones that waited. Type the flag's name to confirm.

accrue.off: Payout work will stop: no price is fixed when a florist accepts and no prepaid payout is made. The work waits and is done once this is on again. Type the flag's name to confirm.
accrue.on: Payout work that waited will be done now, then each time a florist accepts. Type the flag's name to confirm.

form.frozen: Used on {count, plural, one {# live order} other {# live orders}}, so the offer is fixed. To change it, make a new code. Dates, uses, status, campaign and note stay editable.

preview.title: Cost preview
preview.lead: Every bouquet and destination in scope, at the default size, in the destination's currency. Updates as you type; nothing is saved.
preview.belowTitle: {count, plural, one {# bouquet would sell} other {# bouquets would sell}} at or below what we pay the florist.
preview.belowItem: {product} in {country}: {margin} after the discount. You can still save: we pay for the discount, never the florist.
preview.claimTitle: A lower price in the last 30 days.
preview.claimItem: {product} in {country} was {lowest} in the last 30 days and is {today} today. A public percentage off is measured against that lower price. Narrow the bouquets, or announce the amount without a percentage.
preview.empty: Nothing in scope has a price yet.
preview.truncated: Showing the first {count} bouquet and destination pairs.

disabled.banner: Disabled. A buyer who types it sees the same message as for a code that does not exist.

dialog.title: Disable {code}?
dialog.body: It stops working at once, also for buyers who applied it and have not paid yet: their last checkout step shows the new total before they pay.

error.percentHasAmount: A percent code has no amount off.
error.fixedNeedsAmount: Give an amount off in at least one currency.
error.amountAboveCeiling: At most half the minimum order.
error.minorUnits: Enter an amount such as 5 or 5.00.
error.endsBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
error.instant: Enter a date and a time.
error.offerFrozen: Fixed after the first live use. Make a new code to change it.

webhook.dead: Payment or email webhook stopped processing

outbox.dead: An order step failed for good

payment.amount_mismatch: Payment amount does not match the order
payment.paid_not_routed: Paid order not sent to a florist
payment.captured_after_close: Payment captured after the order closed
payment.dispute_outside_machine: Dispute on an order in an unexpected state
payment.refund_state_mismatch: Refund state does not match Stripe
payment.refund_exceeds_captured: Refund asked for more than was captured

routing.no_partner: No florist left for an order

order.not_accepted: Order not accepted by a florist yet
order.not_delivered: Delivery today not done by evening

fx.aging: Exchange rates will go stale soon

invoice.nbp_failed: NBP exchange rate unavailable for an invoice

buyer.link_cap: Sign-in emails near the hourly cap

message.openLog: Open the alert log to see them.

email.footer: Internal: sent to OPS_ALERT_EMAIL, never forwarded to a buyer or a florist.
email.stormSubject: Many alerts at once: open the alert log

summary.subject: Daily alert summary for {date}
summary.orders: Orders due today: {today} ({todayAtRisk} at risk). Tomorrow: {tomorrow} ({tomorrowAtRisk} at risk).
summary.pagesCapped: Paged 3 times in 24 hours, now email only: {count}

finance.title: Finance
finance.intro: Management figures for live orders, in {currency} at each order's own rates. Not accounting records.
finance.testIntro: Stripe test-mode payments only. Never added to live figures.

error.from_after_to: From must be on or before To.
error.too_long: Choose a range of {max} days or fewer.
error.not_a_date: This is not a date. Pick one from the calendar.

question.payoutVat: florist VAT in the agreed amount

tax.note: Until a sign-off file exists, VAT figures are estimates. These are management figures, not accounting records.

totals.title: Totals
totals.ratesUsed: Rates used: each order at its own rates, ECB on its paid day and Stripe as settled.
totals.includesProvisional: Includes {count, plural, one {# provisional order} other {# provisional orders}}.

counts.title: Figures
counts.note: Provisional figures can still change; each order says why.

owed.title: Owed and paid, all florists
owed.note: Each currency on its own; never added together.

florist.title: By florist
florist.caption: Figures by florist
florist.note: A florist row opens that florist's orders for the same range.

vat.title: VAT estimate by country
vat.caption: VAT included in prices, by destination country
vat.note: The VAT already inside each price, less the VAT of refunds (estimated pro rata where no credit note exists). The VAT return is the accountant's.

empty.title: No paid orders in this range
empty.body: {from} to {to}, {basis}, {mode}. Figures start with the first live payment.

finance.rateMissing: {count, plural, one {# order has no ECB rate. Its {currency} figures are left out of the totals and its own-currency figures are listed.} other {# orders have no ECB rate. Their {currency} figures are left out of the totals and their own-currency figures are listed.}}

allProvisional.title: Every figure in this range is provisional.
allProvisional.body: Stripe fees or florist costs are still to come. Each order lists its reasons.

orders.title: Order figures
orders.intro: One row per paid order, with its rates. Management figures, not accounting records.
orders.caption: Orders with their money, newest paid first
orders.footNote: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · newest paid first. The CSV lists them by paid date, then reference.
orders.emptyBody: Nothing in this range with these filters.

reason.fees_pending: Fee pending: Stripe has not reported this payment's fee yet
reason.fees_unsupported_provider: Fee not available: this payment provider does not report fees here yet
reason.refund_pending: Refund pending: a refund is requested and not settled yet
reason.florist_not_assigned: No florist yet: no florist has accepted this order
reason.florist_cost_pending: Florist cost pending: the agreed amount until the payout line is written
reason.adjustment_open: Adjustment open: a change to the florist amount is still undecided
reason.fx_rate_missing: Rate missing: no ECB rate in the {days} days before the date

money.title: Money
money.fxNote: Stripe's conversion against the ECB rate
money.noFeeRow: No fee row yet: settled taken as gross at ECB
money.vatEstimate: refund VAT estimated pro rata, no credit note yet
money.feeStripe: Stripe fee, in {currency}, from the balance transaction
money.feeNotAvailable: Fee not available for this provider
money.readOnly: Read only. Management figures in {currency}; amounts change in Payouts, refunds in Actions.
money.notPaid: No captured payment yet, so this order has no money figures.

layout.sentTo: Sent to {variable}. Internal: never forwarded to a buyer or a florist.

noFlorist.subject: No florist: {reference} · {city} · {date}
noFlorist.band: Cancels automatically at {time} {zone} time unless you act.
noFlorist.bandTomorrow: Cancels automatically at {time} tomorrow, {date}, {zone} time, unless you act.
noFlorist.heading: No florist took order {reference}
noFlorist.noCandidate: No florist covers this date and place
noFlorist.what: Reroute to a florist you have phoned, or cancel, from the order page. The buyer has paid; a cancel refunds in full.

whatsapp.subjectOffer: WhatsApp: new order for {florist} · answer by {time}
whatsapp.preheader: Paste the message below into the chat with {shop}.
whatsapp.headingStop: Paste this stop message into WhatsApp
whatsapp.note: The florist has the same offer by email already. Never accept or decline for them; ask them to open the order.

prepaidReady.subject: Prepaid payout ready: {partnerCode} · {amount}
prepaidReady.preheader: Prepaid order {number} of {limit}. Send the statement and pay it this week.
prepaidReady.heading: A prepaid payout is ready to send
prepaidReady.note: Send the statement, then add it to the next Wise export. The florist is paid before they make the bouquet.

ready.subject: {count, plural, one {# payout ready for review} other {# payouts ready for review}}
ready.preheader: Weekly payouts closed after Sunday. Send the statements, then pay through Wise.
ready.heading: Weekly payouts are ready
ready.lead: {count, plural, one {# weekly payout closed after Sunday.} other {# weekly payouts closed after Sunday.}} Review any flagged line, then send the statements.
ready.needLookBoth: {count} (a line to review, an open adjustment)

lineMissing.subject: No payout line: {reference}
lineMissing.preheader: The delivery photo arrived {minutes} minutes ago and the florist's line is not written.
lineMissing.band: The delivery photo arrived {minutes} minutes ago and no payout line exists.
lineMissing.heading: A delivered order has no payout line
lineMissing.note: The usual cause: the florist has no price for this bouquet and size. Add it on the florist page; the line is written on the next retry.
